heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 115–245, div. B, title I, § 117(b)(1), Sept. 28, 2018, 132 Stat. 3067

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–204, title I, § 100, Mar. 5, 1970, 84 Stat. 26, made the Working Capital Fund available for expenses necessary for personnel functions in regional administrative offices.
